description: This file defines a Java interface called Credentials within the org.openmrs.api.context package. It specifies methods for obtaining the authentication scheme and client name required for authentication schemes in OpenMRS, starting from version 2.3.0.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: An interface that requires implementing classes to define methods for retrieving the authentication scheme and client name for authentication purposes.

methods.name: getAuthenticationScheme
methods.description: Returns the authentication scheme to be used with these credentials.

methods.name: getClientName
methods.description: Returns a string identifying the owner of the credentials, often the username.
